rounds: I would rather own one expensive thing than five cheap ones.
People who wear big logos are showing off.
Expensive watches are a waste of money now that everybody has a phone.
Luxury brands are bad for the planet.
A luxury brand should never have a sale.
Paying €1,000 for a handbag can be a sensible decision.
Luxury brands should make their products in Europe.
Old brands are more trustworthy than new ones.
